section.div: Free, open-source IPTV player for Android TV, Fire TV / Firestick, phones and tablets. M3U, Xtream Codes, XMLTV TV guide, remote and touch, 41 languages. A TiviMate alternative where every feature is free. Player only: bring your own subscription.
